verdict: Paid Instagram is generating leads near industry norms, but weak call volume and tiny social reach are capping growth.
diagnosis: This period you spent $7,835 on Instagram and got 54 leads at $145 each — right at the non-branded search benchmark, but calls dropped to 71.

signals.headline: 54 leads at $145 each
signals.detail: Instagram lead form delivered steady volume this period. Cost per lead sits at the higher end of what's healthy for HVAC.

signals.headline: 71 call clicks from Google profile
signals.detail: Phone taps are the highest-intent action for HVAC. This number is low given 218 five-star reviews driving trust.

signals.headline: 200,666 impressions, 1,886 clicks
signals.detail: Click rate near 0.9% is thin for a lead-form campaign. Creative fatigue is a likely culprit after a full 28-day flight.

signals.headline: 218 reviews averaging 5.0 stars
signals.detail: Reputation is a genuine competitive asset. It is being underused in ad creative and profile calls-to-action.

signals.headline: 171 Instagram followers, 26 profile visits
signals.detail: Organic social presence is negligible. Paid is doing all the work with no owned audience to retarget or nurture.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Service Ads alongside Instagram
recommendations.detail: Consider adding LSA to capture high-intent phone calls. Benchmarks show $72–$95 per lead versus your current $145, and your 5.0 rating qualifies you for the badge.

recommendations.title: Refresh Instagram creative before click rate drops further
recommendations.detail: Test three new lead-form ads this month. Feature review quotes and the free instant bid offer. Current creative has run the full 28 days.

recommendations.title: Pivot September ads to furnace tune-ups
recommendations.detail: AC demand fades in six weeks. Worth exploring a seasonal tune-up offer now to keep the pipeline full through fall shoulder season.
